rationale: This mutation eliminates the -$18.3k cash deficit by unlocking contiguous land expansion up to an optimal 14-16 plot ceiling while preserving the unthrottled 10-hand rush, breaking the starter-acreage revenue trap without repeating the labor-dilution and cash-starvation failures of Gens 25-27. It extends 2.0x-3.5x Town Shop contract fulfillment through step 712 with active-contract inventory protection, allowing uncommitted surplus crops to monetize freely on the open market. Finally, it introduces strict agronomic maturation phase-gates (halting Pumpkins Day 24, Tomatoes Day 26, Carrots Day 28, all seeds step 708), mandates workforce cluster harvesting to eliminate transit waste, and corrects phantom feed reserves on zero-animal farms.
